gameMetadata.title: GUILT
gameMetadata.description: A choice-based narrative adventure game exploring memory, guilt, and redemption

start.text: You stand before the rotting wooden school building. The sky is grey. You feel a jolt in your chest, your GUILT lies here. You've come to finish what was left undone years ago.

scene_2.name: CORRIDOR
scene_2.text: You step inside. The smell hits you—a mix of mold and old floor cleaner. The past is leaking into the present. You remember that your locker is at the end of the hallway.

scene_3.name: YOUR LOCKER
scene_3.text: You are in your sanctuary. There's a picture of the two of you on the locker door. The map shows four circled locations. The basement entrance has been blacked out.

basement_blocked_temp.name: BASEMENT
basement_blocked_temp.text: The basement is sealed off for now. Come back later.

loc_cafeteria.name: CAFETERIA
loc_cafeteria.text: Tables are overturned. The air reeks of rancid grease. In the middle of the hall you see a ghostly figure sitting alone at an intact table. The kitchen area is dark.

loc_cafeteria_memory.name: CAFETERIA
loc_cafeteria_memory.text: You are sitting at the same table. The popular kids invite you over. Your friend whispers, 'Don't go.' You stand up, laugh and shout loud: 'Sorry, I can't deal with your whining.' You leave them alone.

loc_kitchen.name: KITCHEN
loc_kitchen.text: The kitchen is rotting at the seams. You see the rot pile up in the air. The smell is horrendous.

action_get_flashlight.name: KITCHEN
action_get_flashlight.text: Your hand hits cold metal. You found an industrial flashlight!

loc_yard.name: BACKYARD
loc_yard.text: The corner at the back of the school. The wall has a weird graffiti on it. You still smell the teen rebelry around.

steps.text: Your friend looks gaunt. 'Just to make sure you don't steal my lighter again I'm going to write my name on it.'
YOU look down. There it is. A lighter with the name "AXEL" written on it.

loc_yard_memory.name: BACKYARD
loc_yard_memory.text: Your friend looks gaunt. 'Just to make sure you don't steal my lighter again I'm going to write my name on it.'

loc_teachers.name: TEACHERS' LOUNGE
loc_teachers.text: The air is stale. You always wondered what the teachers were doing behind closed doors.

steps.text: The cop asked, 'When did you last see him?' You answered: 'That day at lunch. I thought they went home.' You lied. You knew exactly where THEY were.

loc_teachers_memory.name: TEACHERS' LOUNGE
loc_teachers_memory.text: The cop asked, 'When did you last see him?' You answered: 'That day at lunch. I thought they went home.' You lied. You knew exactly where THEY were.

loc_key_wall.name: TEACHERS' LOUNGE
loc_key_wall.text: Most hooks are empty. One rusty key still hangs.

action_get_key.name: TEACHERS' LOUNGE
action_get_key.text: You take the key. A bit of tape reads: 'BASEMENT'.

loc_classroom.name: CLASSROOM
loc_classroom.text: Dust dances in the beams of light. In the back row one desk sits apart from the others. A chalkboard stands at the front.

loc_desk.name: CLASSROOM
loc_desk.text: This is THEIR desk. You remember. It was a dare.

visualEffects.text: This is THEIR desk. You remember. It was a dare.

loc_board.name: CLASSROOM
loc_board.text: On the board is code: 'if (name == ____) { remember(); }'. Do you know the name?

loc_board_success.name: CLASSROOM
loc_board_success.text: At least YOU remember that much.

basement_entry.name: BASEMENT DOOR
basement_entry.text: A heavy metal door. The sign reads 'ENTRY FORBIDDEN'.

basement_locked.name: LOCKED
basement_locked.text: The door won't budge. You need a key.

basement_stairs.name: STAIRCASE
basement_stairs.text: The door opens. Before you lie pitch-black stairs. The smell is nauseating. Are you ready to step into the darkness?

basement_main.name: MAIN CHAMBER
basement_main.text: The beam hits soft soil. In the corner something metallic glints. There is no going back.

basement_stuck.name: NO RETURN
basement_stuck.text: The door is locked behind you. You must face this.

basement_digging.name: DIGGING
basement_digging.text: You strike the shovel into the ground. Thud. Fabric... bone. The final memory surfaces.

basement_question.name: CORPSE
basement_question.text: Before you is a mummified body. Its jaw drops open. A voice echoes in your head: 'WHO AM I?'

ending_1.name: ENDING #1
ending_1.text: Fear wins over curiosity. You walk away. In the nights that follow you have nightmares, but you never learn the truth.

ending_2.name: ENDING #2
ending_2.text: You step into darkness without light. Your foot slips. You tumble down the stairs and your neck breaks. The shadows consume you.

ending_3.name: ENDING #3
ending_3.text: You answer wrong. 'You still don't care!' the voice screams. The basement walls glow red. Fire engulfs you. You are in hell.

ending_4.name: ENDING #4
ending_4.text: You whisper 'Axel'. The body goes silent. But then the police burst in. You have no evidence (Name missing) that it was suicide. You are convicted of murder.

ending_true.name: TRUE ENDING
ending_true.text: You whisper 'Axel' and give the name. A spirit leaves the body. He looks at peace. 'This can't hurt me anymore,' he laughs. You are forgiven.

epilogue.name: EPILOGUE
epilogue.text: You sit together in the backyard. You and a ghost. You smoke in silence. Smoke rises toward the sky. You are free.

smoking_hints: The basement is bound to be dark. I need something to light the way
I remember their face. But their name escapes me
The basement is bound to be locked. I better look around for the key.
I should look around more. There's something I'm forgetting.

loc_kitchen.message: The kitchen is too dark to explore without a light source.

loc_yard.message: There's something in the backyard you're not ready to face yet.

loc_teachers.message: Something in the teacher's lounge is keeping you back.
